international.title: London commuters braced for disruption as tube strike begins
international.summary: Industrial action by RMT drivers expected to cause severe disruption on Thursday and Friday Severe disruption is expected across the London Underground on Thursday and Friday, when many tube drivers will go on strike. Drivers who are part of the national union of rail, maritime and transport workers (RMT) will strike for 24 hours from noon on Thursday, in the first of a fresh wave of strikes in the long-running dispute over the planned introduction of a four-day working week.
